author: Haruko
name: BattleMetric
short: BattleMetrics, HLL RCON moderation, stats, TK watch, protection, VIP, and dog-tag review cog.
description: Modular Redbot cog for BattleMetrics server data, linked BattleMetrics and HLL: Vietnam RCON bans and unbans, authorized in-game messages, kill feeds, team-kill watch and admin alerts, two-stage seeding with configurable warning duration, HQ protection, timed and seeding-reward VIPs, VIP team switching, PostgreSQL statistics, account linking, and custom dog-tag review.
install_msg: BattleMetric loaded. Use [p]help battlemetric, [p]help serverinfo, [p]help killfeed, [p]help dogtag, /link, /vnstat, or /hllvn.
end_user_data_statement: Reads BattleMetrics, HLL RCON, PostgreSQL, and tagweb IPC secrets from Red's shared API-token storage; stores settings, authorized Discord user IDs, admin-alert role and channel IDs, seeding, HQ-protection, and team-kill watch settings, the VIP team-swap toggle, timed VIP records, short-lived team-kill alert and player-watch records, and pending dog-tag review metadata; temporarily queues in-game admin report text and team-kill events in memory and tracks game player IDs, teams, positions, and death counters in memory for territory protection; stores account links and HLL statistics in PostgreSQL; stores staged or approved dog-tag PNGs in the configured host directory; and sends moderation targets, messages, reasons, durations, and acting Discord administrator IDs and names to the configured external services.
